notes.title: The Future Of The Forgotten
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been a long time since I have updated this game etc. I just wanted to give you some information about the future of this game.

As of right now, I have it planned that I am going to do a rework for this game. The reason for this is because over the years I have become much much better at everything to do with gamedev, I have become a better programmer, have more resources, knowledge on how to optimise games etc etc.

[b]So, I will admit, the re work will be far into the future as right now my priority's are as follows
[/b]
[b]- Finish developing Unknown Presence + Support for the game + extras (This is the new game)
- Finish the remake I'm doing on my other previous title "The Entity"
- And then I will work on the rework for The Forgotten.[/b]

So, my new game comes out in July, so the remake for The Entity will be by the end of the year, so the rework for this game will probably be early 2025. I know this is a very long time in the future, but I wanted to communicate it with you all as I am really wanting this games experience to be good for everyone, and I am aware of the numerous issues this game has.

Thank you all very much and I really hope you all are excited for this even though it's ages away! :)

notes.title: Halloween Update Is Here!!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Happy Halloween in the coming days, to celebrate I have made a small update all Halloween themed. This update adds some temporary changes and some extra objects to the game. Hop into the game to see them yourself before they're gone! [u][b][Game will go back to normal on the 4th of November][/b][/u]

notes.title: Update V1.09
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b],
I know it has been a while since the last update, that's due to me being unsure on things to add and the stuttering issue really took me this long to figure out a way to fix/work around.[i][b](There will still be small stutter when enemies spawn in due to the nature of this work around but that will reduce the stutter from 100% of the time to around 10% of the time and I am continuing to work on this issue)[/b][/i]
There will still be more updates in the future as well as I still plan on fixing/adding/changing a bunch of things. 

[b]Anyway, here are the update notes for this small update (V1.09)
[/b]
- Have changed the moss/grass texture that is on top of rocks
- Have moved and re-scaled a few environmental objects around the start area
- Have added a new construction zone at start of game carpark area
- Have changed the shadow settings for low quality setting to show more shadow details
- Have extended terrain lod to help with terrain fragments appearing too close to camera
- Minor bug fixes(a few collider issue glitches)
[b]- Have done a work around to reduce the stuttering. (Please let me know how it is on your system.)[/b]

[b]Thank you all so much[/b], I hope you all enjoy this update! :)

notes.title: Important Update Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to let you all know that I am still working on The Forgotten and am working on getting an update finished. It may be a little longer until the new update as I am trying to fix majority of the issues. For a start the main thing I’m trying to make work better is enemy and animal AI systems (specifically enemy) to try and make them feel more alive and meaningful. 

I am also working on some performance improvements and just overall issue fixes and making systems a bit more polished. I’m a one man team working on this so it may take a bit for the next update but it will be a good update that should alleviate many of the issues and problems! 
I look forward to seeing what you all think when the new update is published!

Thank you all for being honest in reviews and patient so far! :)

notes.title: Update V1.08
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I have another update for you all here, this one is mainly focused on adding some extra sounds/a few sound scares etc. The patch notes are below!

[b]Added In Update[/b]
- Added a faint heartbeat sound when enemies are near the player
- Have changed some foliage LODs to remove shadows when they're not needed to help with performance
- Added a gasp sound effect when player finds some bodies
- Added a fly effect and sound to some dead bodies 
- Added some extra sounds around the map
- Have tweaked the deer ai a bit to make them better
- Have mildly tweaked some of the enemies damage stats, attraction stats & reaction stats 
- Extra fog added into main area

Thank you all so much, I will be doing more updates for this game but they will be slow to come out! :)

notes.title: Update V1.07

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

notes.title: Small update

notes.title: Game Update V 1.03
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Here are the contents of the update today. Keep in mind not everything has been fixed and in future updates this will be changed to be better [achievements are still a problem but will be fixed soon]

- Fixed loading screen from credits to main menu
- Altered a few names in the credits
- Fixed issue where shard wouldn't allow you to use meteorite
- Added a new flashlight icon that indicates the charge of the flashlight
- Replaced a few old variations of the health bottle with newer ones [no longer stuck in key items inventory]
- Fixed some lights not having volumetric light
- Added a world fog for more ambience
- Added description text to the inventory explaining what it is used for
- Boxes no longer have button press icon, they can be moved by player walking into them
- Have edited secret areas objects to be lower poly to help with the lag
- Change the med health bottles so you can't use them if your health is too high
- Fixed issue where barn had no navigation mesh
- Fixed an issues where one of the ending weren't working properly
- Various small fixes and additions

Thank you all so much, I hope you enjoy this new update! :)

notes.title: Update Version 1.02

Also I am working on improving the enemy AI fully.

- Removed left over objects that are not supposed to be in final build

- Enemy AI should now notice player better (the ones sitting down for the most part)
- Fixed one of the combo notes not being able to be used
- Removed some of the enemies
- Friends at start now have backpacks
- Removed various items around map that were not needed
- Other various fixes
- Have altered some of the UI to make it be clicked easier and to help with issues

Thank you all, I will continue to fix and make this game better for you all :)

notes.title: Game Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We know the creation of this game has taken a long time, we've had some set backs and would have like to have had it already released but we were unable to. But now we are happy to say that our release window for The Forgotten is late Q2 2020 [End of June].
The reason behind this release window is the game is basically completed but need that extra time to add in last minute things, a few change of plans things, testing and just to make sure the game actually runs well. Again we are sorry for it taking a long while but we are sure you will enjoy it when released!

Regards, Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Development Log 4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

- For the past 2 weeks or so we have been working on trying to fix a few major optimisation issues within a few areas. We are still unsure what is causing it but we are getting closer to finding out why, we hope to have this issue fixed as soon as possible.
- We are also working on a few AI issues where they are unable to path correctly, we are working on this issue and trying to get it working.

- Other than those issues we have added in another 2 area locations[New screenshots will show at least one of them] into locations that didn't feel "full".
- And we have been adding new sounds to the game to give it more of a real life feeling and to make it give you more of the sense of fear while going through the map. 


We will be posting 3 new screenshots and a few of the current ones will be getting updated tomorrow so keep and eye on the store page tomorrow for more of a look into what The Forgotten will look like!


Thank you all!
Regards, Ragdoll Inc
